note: Both sets contain exactly the same 17 claims, differing only in ordering (the handrail material claim appears in a different position). Both bind the cladding, siding, handrail, solar tube, door swing and keynote facts correctly with supporting quotes. Both also repeat the cladding material fact under two phrasings and both omit the note that valves and piping are not shown.
remarks: The two sets are content-identical, so the comparison is trivially a tie. Both state the cedar cladding material twice (once as 'CEDAR', once as '1x4 tongue & groove cedar'), and both leave out the note that necessary valves and piping are not shown, which is arguably an engineering-relevant omission. The text layer misspells 'TONNGUE' as on the drawing; both sets preserve the drawing's spelling in quotes.
